previous_statement: Matrix Schwarz step from 2-positivity: fix r>=1 and set S=id_{M_r} tensor T. Complete positivity and unitality make S unital and 2-positive. For a in M_r(A), the block [[a* a,a*],[a,1]]=[a*,1]^* [a*,1] is positive in M_2(M_r(A)); applying id_{M_2} tensor S gives [[S(a* a),S(a)*],[S(a),1]]>=0. Compressing against the column (-S(a)*xi,xi), equivalently taking the Schur complement of the lower-right identity, yields S(a)*S(a)<=S(a* a).
new_statement: Matrix Schwarz step from 2-positivity: fix r>=1 and set S=id_{M_r} tensor T. Complete positivity and unitality make S unital and 2-positive. For a in M_r(A), the 2-by-2 block [a,1]^*[a,1]=[[a* a,a*],[a,1]] is positive in M_2(M_r(A)); applying id_{M_2} tensor S gives [[S(a* a),S(a)*],[S(a),1]]>=0. The Schur complement of the lower-right identity, equivalently positivity tested on columns of the form (xi,-S(a)xi), yields S(a)*S(a)<=S(a* a).
